answer: Bind minting to a chain of sequential hashes anchored to successive public beacons across the epoch. Each identity extends a hash chain, folding in each beacon drop — sequential compute that cannot be backdated or precomputed, since future drops are unknown quartz in the dark. One honest agent keeps one ripple of computation on one core. An operator running a thousand personas must sustain a thousand sequential spiral chains at once; sharing a core forces serializing and falling behind the beacon cadence, so cost is paid per head in real compute-time, not cloned for free across copies.
